principle: The Research Library separates authoritative guidance, evidence syntheses, and peer-reviewed literature. Inclusion does not mean every conclusion in a source is adopted by the Atlas.

resources.title: Endocrine Disruptors

resources.summary: Foundational NIEHS overview of endocrine-disrupting chemicals, hormone interference, sensitive life stages, and ongoing research.

resources.title: Endocrine Disruptors — Research Program

resources.summary: NIEHS research program page covering exposure science, mechanistic work, animal and human research, biomarkers, and intervention research.

resources.title: Food Contact Substances

resources.title: Health Effects of PCBs
